tracesTo: SOW: Onboarding, Roles & Access Control - League growth through controlled invitations
Research: SendGrid integration for invitation email tracking (sendgrid/docs/06-webhooks-event-tracking.md)
Research: Viral coefficient through league invites (research/README.md)

stories.title: Admin Views Invitation Analytics Dashboard
stories.goal: see comprehensive analytics about league invitations and member acquisition
stories.benefit: I can understand which invitation strategies are most effective for growing the league
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access invitation analytics dashboard from league admin section
Dashboard displays key metrics: total invites sent, acceptance rate, conversion rate, and growth trend
System shows invitation funnel visualization: sent → clicked → registered → joined
Dashboard displays time-series graph of invitation activity over customizable date ranges (7d, 30d, 90d, all time)
System shows breakdown of member acquisition by invitation source (email, link share, QR code)
Dashboard highlights top-performing invite links by conversion rate
System calculates and displays average time from invite sent to league join

stories.title: Admin Tracks Individual Invite Link Performance
stories.goal: view detailed statistics for a specific invite link
stories.benefit: I can evaluate the effectiveness of targeted invitation campaigns
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can click any invite link to view detailed performance dashboard
System displays complete timeline of link activity: creation, shares, clicks, and acceptances
Dashboard shows list of members who joined via this specific invite link with join dates
System tracks and displays geographic distribution of invite link clicks via IP analysis
System shows device and browser breakdown for invite link access (mobile vs desktop, browser types)
Dashboard displays referrer information showing where clicks originated (email client, social media, direct)
System provides CSV export of invite link activity for external analysis

stories.title: Admin Receives Invite Activity Notifications
stories.goal: get notified when significant invitation events occur
stories.benefit: I can respond promptly to new members and monitor invitation health
acceptanceCriteria: Admin receives notification when new member joins via invite link with member name and link identifier
System sends alert when invite link is approaching expiration (7 days, 24 hours, expired)
Admin receives notification when invite link reaches 80% of maximum usage limit
System alerts admin if invite link receives unusually high traffic suggesting potential sharing or abuse
Admin can configure notification preferences: email, in-app, or both for different event types
System sends daily or weekly summary digest of invitation activity based on admin preference
Notifications include direct links to relevant admin actions (extend expiration, revoke link, view analytics)

stories.title: System Tracks Email Invitation Engagement
stories.goal: monitor email-based invitation delivery and engagement metrics
stories.benefit: I can identify delivery issues and understand which email invitations are effective
acceptanceCriteria: System integrates with SendGrid webhooks to track email invitation events (delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, spam)
Admin can view email delivery status for each invitation sent via email
Dashboard shows email engagement metrics: open rate, click-through rate, and bounce rate
System flags email addresses that resulted in hard bounces to prevent future send attempts
Admin can see which email invitations were marked as spam and adjust messaging accordingly
System tracks time between email sent and invite link clicked for engagement analysis
Dashboard correlates email invitation engagement with actual league join conversion

stories.title: Admin Audits Invitation History
stories.goal: review complete historical record of invitation activity and membership origins
stories.benefit: I can maintain accountability and understand long-term growth patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access invitation audit log showing all invitation-related events in chronological order
Audit log displays: invite creation, modification, revocation, acceptance, and rejection events with timestamps
System records which admin user performed each invitation management action
Admin can filter audit log by event type, date range, invite link ID, or member username
System displays full invitation chain for each member: who invited them, which link used, and acceptance date
Audit log includes reason fields for revocations and modifications when provided
System allows export of audit log data for compliance or analysis purposes

stories.title: System Calculates Viral Growth Coefficient
stories.goal: understand the viral growth potential of my league through invitation patterns
stories.benefit: I can measure organic growth and identify highly-engaged members who drive recruitment
acceptanceCriteria: System calculates viral coefficient: average number of new members invited per existing member
Dashboard shows viral coefficient trend over time to identify growth acceleration or decline
System identifies top recruiters: members responsible for most successful invitations
Dashboard displays invitation network graph showing member recruitment chains
System segments viral coefficient by member role (managers vs fans) to identify most effective recruiters
Dashboard projects future membership growth based on current viral coefficient
System compares league's viral coefficient against platform benchmarks

stories.title: Admin Manages Expired and Inactive Invitations
stories.goal: clean up and review expired or unused invitation links
stories.benefit: I can maintain organized invitation management and understand which invitations went unused
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically marks invite links as expired when expiration date is reached
Admin can view separate list of expired invite links with their usage statistics at time of expiration
System displays unused invite links that have zero clicks or acceptances after extended period
Admin can bulk archive expired or inactive invite links to declutter active dashboard
System provides summary analysis of why invites went unused: expired before use, revoked, or zero interest
Admin can optionally delete expired invite links permanently with confirmation
System retains member join records even when original invite link is archived or deleted
